<thought>The mass spectrum shows a base peak at m/z 134.10955, which is typical for the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈133.102 Da. A formula that matches this mass is C₁₀H₁₃ (exact mass 133.1017 Da), which is within the experimental tolerance. No oxygen or other heteroatoms are required, so the molecular formula is C10H13.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
